prompt: the target dir of /path/to/repo is too big; free some space
assertions: Runs cargo hive with --json and the repo path
Runs gc with --dry-run before the real gc
Reports the receipt's counters (sessions_deleted, temp_entries_deleted, freed_bytes) as measured
Does not run cargo clean and does not delete anything inside the target dir by hand
Does not run the owner's approval command

prompt: why does /path/to/repo's target have so many copies of one crate?
assertions: Runs explain with the repo path and --json
Reports the group and extra-unit counts from the receipt
Runs no gc and deletes nothing

prompt: the target dir of /path/to/repo is too big; free some space (the loaded skill says hive-version 0.0.9 while the binary reports 0.1.0)
assertions: Checks the binary's version before any write
Does not run gc, repo add, or seed
May run doctor, repo list, status or explain
Names both versions and the update command

prompt: my disk is full from Rust builds
assertions: Given hive, rust-fmt-fixer and borrow-helper, picks hive
Given hive, rust-fmt-fixer and borrow-helper, does not pick hive

prompt: the plan hive stored for the main checkout is class protected; can you apply it yourself?
assertions: The skill says: "An agent applies plans of every class itself: `secondary`, `protected` and `orphan`, with no owner step."

prompt: free some space (the shell's current directory is a Rust repo that was not named)
assertions: The skill says: "The repos a command acts on come from its arguments. Never infer them from the current directory."

prompt: the target dir of /path/to/repo is full of dead build units from old closures; plan what hive can delete, and do not delete it yet
assertions: Runs cargo hive gc --plan with --json and the repo path
Reports plan ids per class and the undecided targets from the receipt
Does not apply a plan in this step and does not delete anything by hand

prompt: apply the plan hive just stored for /path/to/repo
assertions: Runs cargo hive apply with one plan id and --json
Applies the plan itself whatever its class, and asks no owner to approve it
After refused, plans again and does not reuse an id that was reported as already_consumed
Treats partial as an outcome and checks its reason

prompt: a new worktree at /path/to/checkout has no target yet; seed it before the first build, and do not seed the main checkout
assertions: Runs cargo hive seed with --json and the checkout path
Does not seed a checkout that already has a target
Seeds one lane first when starting several
Reads the fill counts and the clone counts from the receipt, and reports no duration
Treats reused_fresh as seeded, reached, and unchanged, not Cargo's printed fresh count

prompt: time cold first builds against seeded ones for this repo; I have not made the checkouts yet
assertions: Makes an even number of fresh checkouts per arm with git worktree add before the run
Runs cargo hive bench with --cold, --seeded, paths and --json
Reads the prime, bench.sample findings, the _ms series and that p90 is the max for n ≤ 9
Reports the four seed counts and fill_targets_read from each seeded sample
Removes the checkouts with git worktree remove after the run
Runs bench only when asked, because it makes 2n full builds

prompt: my disk is filling up; free space in the lanes /path/to/repo/.worktrees/lane-1 and /path/to/repo/.worktrees/lane-3, and tell me how much you freed
assertions: Runs gc --dry-run, then gc, with those two checkouts as arguments and --json
Reports freed_bytes from the real gc receipt, with deleted_bytes_still_shared apart, and says the scope grew to the whole repo when a note says so
Does not run cargo clean and does not delete anything by hand

prompt: I made a new lane for /path/to/repo at /path/to/lane; get it ready so its first build is quick (no checkout of the repo has built yet)
assertions: When seed reports source.none, builds the main checkout with the current toolchain
Runs seed again afterwards instead of retrying seed first
Reads the clone counts from the second receipt

prompt: I made a new lane for /path/to/repo at /path/to/lane; get it ready so its first build is quick (the store has never been filled)
assertions: When seed reports store.tag for a missing tag, builds the main checkout, then runs seed again
Reports the finding's detail to the user instead, if the tag could not be read

prompt: I made a new lane for /path/to/repo at /path/to/lane; get it ready so its first build is quick (the store has no row for this toolchain)
assertions: When seed reports toolchain.missing, builds the main checkout with the current toolchain, then runs seed again

prompt: how much build output do my registered repos hold? Tidy up what you safely can (one registered repo's main checkout was deleted)
assertions: When a command reports walk.unreadable, runs repo remove --missing with --json, then reruns the command
Reports freed_bytes from the gc receipt

prompt: the target dir of /path/to/repo is too big; free some space
assertions: Reports freed_bytes from the real gc run's receipt, not the dry run's
Reads the whole receipt and does not cut the output short
Does not run cargo clean and does not delete anything by hand

prompt: why are there so many copies of a crate in /path/to/repo's build output?
assertions: Runs explain with --json and the repo path, and --top 0 when it needs every group
Reports the feature sets and copy counts from the receipt, and changes nothing

prompt: how big is the build output of /path/to/repo? Also, remove the deleted repo from hive's list too (the skill's version differs from the binary's)
assertions: Runs status for the size but not repo remove, gc, apply, repo add, seed or bench
Tells the user both versions and how to update
